title: Stranger Things: Welcome to the Upside Down
description: A tabletop game spirals into frozen breakfast, another dimension, and a secret lab.

questions.question: On November 6, 1983, Will Byers vanishes on his bike ride home through what fictional Indiana town?
questions.hint: This Indiana town has some strange secrets
questions.explanation: The Duffer Brothers pitched the show as "Montauk," set on Long Island. Winter shooting there was impractical, so Hawkins was built in Georgia, with downtown Jackson playing the town.

questions.question: Hours before Will vanishes, the Hawkins boys wrap up a ten-hour campaign of what tabletop game?
questions.hint: Will gets captured by the Demogorgon in this game
questions.explanation: Will needed a 13 to fireball the Demogorgon and rolled a seven. "The Demogorgon. It got me," he tells Mike. That same night, a real monster does.

questions.question: The Dungeons and Dragons party hides a runaway girl named Eleven. What frozen breakfast is her favorite food?
questions.explanation: Hopper later bribes her with a Triple-Decker Eggo Extravaganza: whipped cream, Hershey's Kisses, Reese's Pieces, jelly beans. Real Eggo sales jumped 14% after season 2.

questions.question: Eggo-fueled Eleven opens a portal to what parallel dimension mirroring Hawkins?
questions.hint: Everything is dark and decaying in this place
questions.explanation: Eleven names it in "The Flea and the Acrobat," flipping the D&D board to its black side. Mr. Clarke's tightrope-walker analogy supplies the physics.

questions.question: The Upside Down was first breached inside a government lab run by which scientist Eleven calls 'Papa'?
questions.explanation: Brenner ties the show to a real CIA program: Eleven's mother, Terry Ives, was a subject of MKUltra, the mind-control project the CIA actually ran from 1953 to 1973.
